title: Student Voice:
title_q: “We Are the Ones Who Will Live in It”
title_short: Student · We Will Live in It
headline: A 14-year-old tells a room of adults: we will live in this future, so listen to us.
story: On the panel, a 14-year-old NFTE student tells a room full of adults that young people will live in the world they are deciding. Her own story backs it up: at a hyper-competitive school her ideas were not heard, so she found a way for her peers' ideas to be heard.
It ends with her asking educators to listen, real applause, and J.D. LaRock saying you should end on the wise words of a student. Proud and hopeful. Her name stays off screen.
